pattern.description: Clicking the app logo opens a full-height navigation drawer on the left while a dark scrim dims the page behind it; the change lands in about two frames.
pattern.why_premium: Low premium value on its own: it is a raw screen-recording state change. The scrim does focus attention on the menu, but there is no eased slide or stagger.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(scrim, {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 0.75, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0).fromTo(drawer, {xPercent: -100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power3.out'}, 0).from(drawer.querySelectorAll('li'), {opacity: 0, x: -12, stagger: 0.02, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0.1); the source cuts nearly instantly, so this is an upgraded version.
build_hint.remotion: drawer translateX = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 220}}), [0, 1], [-150, 0]); scrim opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 8], [0, 0.75], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); menu items offset by i * 1 frame.

notes: Energy spikes over two frames only (f2446-f2447), so the source is effectively a hard state change; the slide on the drawer is inferred, not seen. b15 (Home) stands in for the whole menu list because no candidate covers all items.
